verdict.rationale: AnyDesk documents its own session history. Admins can monitor sessions in the my.anydesk portal, and the REST API can retrieve session history for a selected time range and collect session logs. Its open-source Python module can export session data to CSV. However, the evidence never states that the records include the connecting user, the target machine and timestamps, and export depends on the API and script rather than a built-in audit-report export. Missing for 10: documented session-log fields (who, which machine, when), a native one-click audit export in the portal, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can see a log of who connected to which machine and when, exportable for audit
